title: African SDG Bibliometric Analysis (2015–2025): Reproducibility Package
description:
Reproducibility materials for the bibliometric and scientometric analysis of Sustainable Development Goal-related research across all 54 African Union member states and all 17 SDGs from 2015 to 2025.

The release includes query documentation, processing and analysis code, configuration files, analytical parameters, derived results, figures and reproducibility documentation. Raw Scopus exports are not included because of third-party licensing restrictions.
